_comment: Journal addresses that no longer carry an article, and where each now points. next.config.js answers each with a permanent (308) redirect, and prisma/seed-journal.ts deletes the matching row. A retired address must never be reused for a different article. The original text of the first six retired posts is kept, unchanged, in lib/data/blog.ts; the later ones are in git history (content/journal/<slug>.md before the commit that retired them).
